decision.rationale: 05 v2 §3.4: admission units pass or fail; U7 and U8 are descriptive.

limitations: Both E7 repeats are complete, but 12 known tasks and two repeats remain a descriptive small-sample result, not general/provider reliability or a comparative superiority/equivalence test.
All 36 success receipts and retained call joins are verified, not general task or provider reliability.
No native runtime exceeded 180 seconds; this is not an estimate of the causal effect of changing the budget to 540 seconds.
Retained call accounting is verified, not complete backend billing or all-runtime producer coverage.
Original source5 events have no source6 capture metadata; no retroactive promotion.
Private trajectories and cases were hash-only; session database contents were not independently read; native source reconciliation remains its authority.
U7 has 12 tasks and two registered repeats; no new statistics or fitted criteria were produced.
Historical E6 invalid results remain separate and are not pooled with E7.
Two r1 slots have agent-start skew above 30s (46.497242s and 47.226735s). Their native paired runtime deltas are null; success and repetition reliability remain included.

end.notes: external shared-account usage is included in delta (not subtracted)

u7r1_gate.both_repeat_reliability: measured only in the retained E7 r1 analysis; both complete E7 matrices verified
